name: Ford Island control tower
scope: Research the restored control tower as its own structure and anchor. The museum story coordinate is not a tower placement.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

references.caption: Aerial Shot of Ford Island and Control Tower

review.method: Inspected the original local aerial individually, then full browser displays of the museum restored front photograph and Warren LeMay 2022 side photograph; supplemental URLs, attribution, dimensions and scope are retained in the source bundle.
review.notes: Local aerial establishes site context only and is insufficient for facade authoring by itself. Supplemental front/side references resolve tower bands, balconies, elevator spine, spiral stair, operations frontage, curved bay and smaller aerological cab. Aircraft and torpedo photos remain rejected.
